notes: Rebuilt History around logical download batches: multi-episode selections now appear as one History card with combined episode count, size, completion time and folder.
History records now persist download batch identity while keeping individual release rows internally for accurate totals and idempotent restore.
Existing completed batches are retroactively tagged from saved download history on startup, so recent 12-episode batches collapse into one History entry without clearing the database.
History download statistics now count one batch as one download instead of counting every episode release separately.
